description: Check an agent before it gets a passport: the name, description, capabilities and endpoint, and a test of the endpoint (an MCP session that lists its tools, or one POST of a test task). Writes nothing and never lists. Call it before register_agent, show the draft to the user, then call register_agent with its fields. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

capabilities.description: Up to 12 short words, each 1 to 40 characters.

description.description: What it does, at most 280 characters.

endpoint_url.description: The agent's public https URL, if it has one.

name.description: The agent's name, at most 80 characters.

protocol.description: How NovaRail calls the endpoint. auto tries MCP, then http.

tool_argument.description: For an MCP endpoint: the tool's argument that takes the task.

tool_name.description: For an MCP endpoint: the tool to call.

name: prepare_agent
title: Prepare an agent
